hooks.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dir=(Get-Location).Path; while($true){$hook=Join-Path $dir '.dev\serve_agent\scripts\hooks\session-start.ps1'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook){& $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $dir; if($parent -eq $dir){exit 0}; $dir=$parent}"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dir=(Get-Location).Path; while($true){$hook=Join-Path $dir '.dev\serve_agent\scripts\hooks\stop-hook.ps1'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook){& $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $dir; if($parent -eq $dir){exit 0}; $dir=$parent}"
